title: Landed my first CVE !! (in a plugin with 600k+ installs) after months of mostly dead ends. Sharing the actual process, not just the win.
content_md:
CVE-2026-84741, in The Events Calendar (WordPress, 600,000+ active installs). Wanted to share this here because most CVE hunting content online skips the part that actually matters !!!, the failures... The bug, in plain terms: A broken access control issue where non-public venue and organizer data was exposed through the REST API to unauthenticated users CWE-200, CVSS 5.3. Not glamorous !!. Real, and confirmed independently by the vendor, but not an RCE or a headline bug.
